name: Higashiboujou Akira
source:
This powerful woman isn't to be trifled with, but as Ichinari's Onee-chan she tends to let him get away with almost anything.

Ichinari and Iori's editor. Being super into judo, she's never afraid to be blunt and get straight to the point. Ichinari was her first client, and she soon found herself falling for him. She's got that big sister vibe to her and, although she can come down on him harshly, mostly she's putty in Ichinari's hands. Her employers never refund her expenses, and she's always crying about her meager salary and terrible working conditions.

[From [url=http://nekowork.com/h/en/index.html] Nekowork[/url]]
